sourceRecord.sourceWikitext:
{{Recipe summary
| Category = Rice recipes
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of India|Cuisine of India]]

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (480 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) long-grain [[Cookbook:rice|rice]], cooked 
*2 ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:salt|salt]]
*1 medium [[Cookbook:Eggplant|eggplant]], peeled and [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] into ½-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (1 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) cubes 
*[[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|Vegetable oil]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] whole [[Cookbook:Coriander|coriander]] seeds 
*2 tsp yellow [[Cookbook:Split Pea|split peas]]
*⅛ tsp [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]] 
*1¾-inch (4 cm) stick of [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]] 
*3 tbsp dried unsweetened [[Cookbook:Coconut|coconut]] 
*2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]] 
*¼ tsp [[Cookbook:Turmeric|turmeric]]

==Procedure==
# Place the eggplant into a large bowl and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon salt. Mix well and allow to sit for half an hour, then rinse lightly and allow to drain. 
# Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] over a medium flame. Add the coriander, seeds, split peas, cumin, and cinnamon. Stir well. When the spices have darkened, remove them and place on a plate lined with a [[Cookbook:Paper Towel|paper towel]]. 
# In the same pan, [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] the coconut, stirring constantly. When it turns a golden-brown, remove and place on the paper towel. 
# In another skillet, [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] the eggplant until it is cooked through. It should turn a bruised dark brown. Be careful not to add too much oil in the process. Remove, set aside, and keep warm. 
# Put the dried spices into a [[Cookbook:Mortar and Pestle|mortar]] and grind into a fine powder. You'll find that a well-cleaned coffee grinder works well as a substitute. 
# In a small pot, combine the lemon juice, ½ teaspoon salt, turmeric, and 2 tablespoons water. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]. Lower the heat and allow to [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for 3 minutes. 
# In a skillet, add the cooked rice and the eggplant and sauté with very little oil. Mix well. Allow the mixture to cool. Add 2 more tablespoons of vegetable oil; mix well. Add the coconut-spice mixture and the lemon mixture. Mix well and serve at room temperature.
